sanskrit_verse:
एते च शपथाः प्रोक्ताः अल्पार्थे सुकराः सदा ।
साहसेष्वभिशापेषु दिव्यान्याहुर्विशोधनम् ॥
transliteration: ete ca śapathāḥ proktāḥ alpārthe sukarāḥ sadā / sāhaseṣv abhiśāpeṣu divyāny āhur viśodhanam
sph_interpretive_translation: These oaths are declared for minor matters, always easy to uphold; in acts of audacity and defamation, divine purification is proclaimed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from consciousness integrity, not social rank
Causation aligns with intent clarity and energetic distortion
Capacity-based responsibility escalates with audacious violation
Restoration logic prioritizes energetic cleansing over punitive reaction
Consciousness alignment demands purification as a corrective sequence
executable_legal_axioms: IF act involves minimal consequence AND no energetic disruption THEN simple affirmation suffices
IF act involves audacity OR defamation THEN initiate divine purification protocol
IF actor demonstrates awareness deviation THEN assign consciousness realignment process
IF violation disrupts collective dharma THEN invoke restorative completion sequence
IF intent remains uncorrected THEN escalate to higher-capacity oversight tribunal
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, oaths for trivial matters require only declarative affirmation. However, when accusations involve audacity or defamation that destabilize dharma-field coherence, purification rituals must precede evidentiary evaluation. The threshold of responsibility lies not in proof alone but in energetic impact and consciousness misalignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through energetic traceability, not punitive attribution. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential purification—first energetic cleansing, then truth revelation. Proportional responsibility corresponds to the degree of consciousness distortion caused. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that suffering is not justice; correction is.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate divine purification ritual to cleanse energetic distortion
Assign responsibility assumption practice until alignment is restored
Implement consciousness recalibration through guided meditative sequences
Deploy integrity reintegration via witnessed corrective declaration
Verify completion through spontaneous harmonization within dharma field
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, these laws are executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
